title: A new home
notes: A new title: the Spire rising, a column of light, tap to begin.

Choose your world: swipe through the worlds, each with its own constellation lighting up as you relight its skies. Continue where you left off, or New to start that world again from sky 1 (your stars and records stay).
Options, Leaderboard, Achievements and the Story along the bottom.
Coins, the forge and paid rebuilds are gone; Endless is put away for now.
